authority.rule: Authority remains with the exact source owner or 00 Authorization. 01 Ops reconciles and schedules only already-authorized exact work; no catch-all authority sink or replacement Main role exists.

runtime_registry.binding_rule: Resolve a stable role_id to a replaceable runtime thread ID at send time.
runtime_registry.history_rule: Refresh the live registry without rewriting this manifest; preserve prior epochs as related_epochs.
runtime_registry.unknown_rule: An absent or unreadable runtime remains UNKNOWN until positive missing, archived, or superseded evidence exists.

recovery_policy.live_apply_gate: independent acceptance receipt naming the manifest digest and plan digest
recovery_policy.active_turn_rule: Never steer, interrupt, repair, or replace an active task. Persist exact pending delivery and let 01 Ops retry only after a proven safe boundary.
recovery_policy.standing_continuation_rule: 01 Ops consumes only canonically authorized READY packets, orders declared dependencies, and dispatches the largest conflict-free writer-scope wave without adding semantic or priority authority. IDLE and notLoaded bindings remain resumable by logical role ID.
recovery_policy.receipt_continuation_rule: 01 Ops releases only the exact writer_scope lease proven terminal by an owner-returning receipt and immediately selects the next already-admitted wave; blocked or latency-bound scopes do not stop unrelated work.
recovery_policy.heartbeat_rule: Heartbeats recover interrupted coordination only. They do not replace foreground receipt-driven scheduling and are not required per owner role.
recovery_policy.unknown_rule: Fail closed on UNKNOWN identity, pin state, active-writer collision, or incomplete post-create readback.
recovery_policy.rollback_rule: Stop after the first failed mutation, retain created runtime IDs, emit a partial-create receipt, and retry by role_id against those retained IDs; never delete as rollback.

envelope_contract.canonical_digest: SHA-256 of canonical UTF-8 JSON payload with sorted keys and compact separators
envelope_contract.source_identity: Every envelope carries source_role_id plus source_runtime thread_id, host_id, and human title. Missing runtime identity fails closed before routing.
envelope_contract.dedupe: Reject or silently suppress an unchanged event_id plus payload_digest. The same event_id with a different digest is a safety incident.
envelope_contract.authorization_requests: Use stable question_id, source correlation, created_at, expires_at, exact options/impact, and route_back_role_id. Evaluate eligible requests against the learned authorization policy before asking the operator. Repeat only OPEN questions; suppress ANSWERED, EXPIRED, superseded, or safely auto-authorized requests.
envelope_contract.inter_thread_labels: Every cross-thread message ends with HANDOFF, RESPONSE_EXPECTED, RETURN_TO, and WAKE_CONDITION. Status copies are not handoffs and do not expect replies.
envelope_contract.context_checkpoint: Every substantive turn persists a compact source-linked checkpoint before handoff, blocker closeout, terminal receipt, or archive. Raw transcripts and secret material are excluded.
envelope_contract.acknowledgement: Acknowledgement is a correlated receipt, never proof that requested work completed.
envelope_contract.supersession: A supersession envelope names every superseded event or runtime epoch and never erases history.

single_writer.root_rule: At most one mutating ATLAS-root implementation writer. 01 Ops enforces the lease but cannot supply missing semantic ownership, source authority, or exceptional priority.
single_writer.owner_rule: At most one mutating writer per owner repository or external resource group; optional scouts are read-only.
single_writer.parallel_rule: Distinct writer_scope values may execute concurrently when dependencies and all declared resource claims are disjoint; global owner-writer serialization is forbidden.
single_writer.lease_release_rule: Release only the exact lease proven terminal by a correlated receipt. BLOCKED, REVIEW_LATENCY, or UNKNOWN retains or quarantines that scope without consuming unrelated capacity.
collision_detection: multiple active runtimes claiming one logical role without accepted supersession
multiple active mutation leases for one writer_scope
same Git branch attached to more than one worktree
runtime cwd or worktree identity different from the admitted packet
unknown task status at a mutation boundary
single_writer.safe_stop: Make no mutation, preserve both candidates, emit BLOCKED with evidence, and return owner-first to the exact source owner or 00 Authorization.

each unique binding is idle or safely queued; writer scopes do not collide

serialization_rules: Phase 0 must finish before any runtime mutation.
01 Ops must be uniquely reconciled under exact existing authority before any dispatch; atlas.main is never recovered or recreated.
Decision and owner-return surfaces may initialize in parallel only after their titles and stable role IDs are unique.
Owner surfaces may initialize in parallel only across distinct writer scopes.
Bootstrap messages serialize per target and use a stable event_id; never send to an active target.
Pin and post-create readback must finish before a created runtime is placed in the live registry.

health.healthy: unique non-archived binding plus title, prompt markers, runtime policy, pin, route, and readback proof
health.degraded: binding exists but one or more non-collision health checks are unproven or stale
health.missing: complete discovery proves no binding exists
health.duplicate: more than one candidate claims a role without accepted supersession
health.blocked: mutation is unsafe because an authority, lease, dependency, or acceptance gate is closed
health.held: known preserved object intentionally excluded from selection
health.unknown: evidence is unavailable or contradictory and must not be inferred
